summary: Single-workspace install is instant, and even public unlisted distribution is self-serve once you complete a checklist. Slack's review only gates the optional Marketplace listing. HTTPS endpoints are mandatory for distributed apps.

approval.typical_timeline: Single-workspace: instant. Unlisted public distribution: minutes (self-serve checklist). Marketplace listing: requires Slack's review against their guidelines (timeline not stated in fetched sources).
approval.notes: Customer workspaces can impose their own admin approval on installs regardless of Slack's stance.

steps.title: Create the app at api.slack.com/apps
steps.detail: A new Slack app is tied to one workspace. Install App to Workspace gives you tokens immediately for that workspace.

steps.title: Configure OAuth scopes
steps.detail: Add the bot/user scopes your app needs in app settings; scopes attach to your tokens.

steps.title: Build the OAuth 2.0 flow for multi-workspace installs
steps.detail: To be installed on other workspaces your app must handle authorization programmatically and generate tokens per workspace.

steps.title: Enable SSL on every endpoint
steps.detail: Distributed apps must support SSL for OAuth redirect URLs, interaction payload request URLs, options load URLs, and Events API URLs.

steps.title: Activate public distribution or submit to the Marketplace
steps.detail: Dashboard -> Manage Distribution -> complete the checklist -> Activate Public Distribution for unlisted sharing (Add to Slack button, shareable URL). Commercial apps should submit to the Slack Marketplace, which is reviewed.

nuances: Deactivating unlisted distribution removes the app from every workspace except the original one; once Marketplace-listed you must discontinue the listing instead.
Apps with scopes beyond bot/incoming-webhook/commands/identify are auto-uninstalled if the installing user leaves the workspace.
Some customer workspaces restrict installs to admins or to Marketplace-listed apps only.
Enterprise Grid orgs change how installs work; read the Enterprise org guide if you target large customers.
agent_can_do: Map your feature list to the minimal scope set
Generate the OAuth exchange and token-storage code
Check your endpoints against the SSL/distribution checklist
human_must_do: Create the app under your Slack account
Submit and respond to Marketplace review if you list
Handle workspace admin approval flows for enterprise customers
